text:
Maria - CS: Hey team, Oakridge cutover is scheduled for 03/12. Quick preflight — any outstanding network/IAM/KMS/audit blockers?
Devon - NetEng: Firewall rules mostly in. Waiting on their infra team to confirm source CIDR for the app workers. Asked for it at 09:12 PDT, pinged again.
Sam - AppEng: We need the private subnet NAT gateway in place or our init hooks fail. Dev tenant shows 502 on our healthcheck if NAT missing.
Aj - Security: KMS key ready but customer wants explicit grant to the cross-account role instead of key policy. Need the role ARN from their IAM team.
Maria - CS: @Devon can you call out exactly which CIDR and who to ping at Oakridge? I'll escalate if we don't have it by EOD.
Devon - NetEng: Sure — asked for oakridge-infra@oakridge.co and /28 for worker pool. Also flagged that their transit gateway route table needs the 10.41.0.0/16 route to our VPC.
Sam - AppEng: Small note — if they NAT via elastic IP, we need to update our allowlist to include that EIP. Otherwise callbacks to our webhook fail.
Aj - Security: Audit logs: they want logs shipped to their central ELK — need S3 bucket path and bucket policy for delivery. I posted an example policy: `{
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"logging.rw-infra"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::oakridge-logs/*"}]}`
Maria - CS: I captured that in the onboarding doc and asked for the S3 bucket name. Also asked them about retention (30 vs 90 days) — they prefer 90.
Devon - NetEng: One more infra item: do we have their ASN for BGP? If they plan direct connect, we need ASN + LOAs.
Sam - AppEng: From app side, suggest a short smoke test doc we can run post-cutover. I can draft today and attach to the runbook.
Aj - Security: KMS rotation schedule — they want automatic rotation. We need their approval to enable key rotation and to confirm backup KMS policies for rollback.
Maria - CS: Risk check: renewal signal is green but this cutover is a gating moment — if cutover slips > 5 business days, account health score drops. I'll flag in CRM.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: oakridge-cutover-window - 2027-03-12T22:00Z -> 2027-03-13T02:00Z
Devon - NetEng: Action items: (1) confirm CIDR + EIP (oakridge) (2) confirm TGW route (oakridge) (3) ASN if DX planned.
Aj - Security: Action items: (1) get role ARN for cross-account grant (2) confirm S3 bucket + policy (3) KMS rotation approval.
Sam - AppEng: Action items: (1) smoke test doc by 15:00 PT (2) verify webhook allowlist after EIP confirmed.
Maria - CS: I'll consolidate and send a single checklist to oakridge-infra@oakridge.co and copy exec sponsor. If we don't have CIDR + role ARN by EOD I'll escalate.
Devon - NetEng: I'll follow up with a quick call at 14:00 PT with their network lead.
Aj - Security: Pinged oakridge-security in thread and shared the example policy.
Maria - CS: Thanks — small ask for feedback capture after cutover: can we add a 5-question form for their infra and app leads? I can send link in post-cutover notes.
Sam - AppEng: +1, helpful. Keep it short.
Maria - CS: OK locking actions. I'll post runbook link when Sam finishes smoke tests. :thumbsup:
